display.purpose: Screen titles, greeting header, streak numbers. Literary warmth.

title.purpose: Section headings, card titles. Clear hierarchy anchor.

body.purpose: Paragraph text, chat messages, descriptions. Comfortable reading.

caption.purpose: Metadata, timestamps, helper text. Supplementary information.

label.purpose: Overlines, section headers, chip text. Structural markers.

button.purpose: All button text. Confident and readable.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Default card elevation. Subtle presence on surface containers.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hero cards, featured elements, active cards.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and toggles. 150-250ms duration.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Persona card press, FAB bounce. Replaced with crossfade under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA button for primary actions like Sign In, Start Review, Browse Library.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d97706; color: #fdfbf7; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 22px; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(30,42,56,0.04); transition: background 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f59e0b; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #e8dfd4; color: #b1bbc9; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Transparent background, gold text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #d97706; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 22px; padding: 14px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Selectable filter chip for library view. Pill shape, warm neutral default, gold active state.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #fdfbf7; color: #6b7f96; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 18px; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #f0e9e0; } .ds-chip-active { background: #d97706; color: #fdfbf7; } .ds-chip-active:hover { background: #f59e0b; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Default container card. Warm cream background, ambient shadow, gently rounded corners.
components.html:
Currently Reading

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input field with icon prefix. Cream warm background, soft rounded corners.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; background: #f9f5f0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 12px; height: 50px; gap: 8px; } .ds-input-icon { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #1e2a38; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7f96; } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #d97706; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Bottom tab bar with 5 tabs. Cream background, gold active state, muted icons for inactive.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #fdfbf7; border-top: 1px solid #f0e9e0; height: 60px; padding: 6px 0 8px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7f96; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-tab-active { color: #d97706; } .ds-tab span { margin-top: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
ReadPal's design system wraps every interaction in warmth. It feels like settling into a favorite armchair with a cup of tea and a book you've been looking forward to all day. The palette is built around warm creams and ambers, the typography pairs a serif display voice with a friendly sans body, and shadows lift cards just enough to feel real without breaking the cozy intimacy.

The system rejects three things categorically: the cold efficiency of SaaS dashboards, the noise of social media feeds, and the sterile file-management feel of Kindle clones. Every screen invites you to stay, not to check metrics. Every card feels like it belongs on a well-loved bookshelf, not in a data table.

Interactive components are refined and restrained. Buttons have gentle curves and warm fills. Inputs sit in cream backgrounds with soft borders. Elevation is clear and structural: cards lift visibly off the surface to announce interactivity, but never shout.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, cream-dominant surfaces that feel like paper, not pixels
Curious Gold accent used sparingly for CTAs, active states, and gamification highlights
Clear structural elevation: cards lift with visible shadows to signal interactivity
Serif display type for warmth, sans for clarity; scale contrast between them
Playful micro-copy and persona greetings that surprise without demanding attention
WCAG AAA contrast targets with dyslexia-friendly reading options

rules.name: The Curious Gold Rule
rules.body: Curious Gold appears on primary actions, active states, and gamification elements only. It never decorates. If more than 10% of a screen's visible area is gold, pull back.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted warm. No cool grays, no blue-grays, no pure whites. The palette stays in the amber-warm hue family end to end.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Crimson Pro is for display text only (screen titles, large numbers). DM Sans handles everything else: body, labels, buttons, captions. Never use Crimson Pro for UI labels or button text.

rules.name: The Scale Discipline Rule
rules.body: The defined scale steps are display, title, body, caption, label, button. Avoid creating intermediate sizes. If a component needs a different size, extend the scale deliberately rather than overriding inline.

rules.name: The Resting State Rule
rules.body: Shadows are present even at rest. ReadPal is not a flat design system. Cards sit slightly above the cream background by default, creating a gentle stacked-paper feel.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Shadows use Inkstone (the text color) as their source, never pure black and never the accent color. No colored glow shadows.

dos: Do keep Curious Gold to primary actions and active states.
Do use clear structural shadows on cards.
Do vary card elevation and background treatment for visual rhythm.
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements.
Do support reduced motion with opacity crossfades.
Do use Crimson Pro only for display headings.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + gradient accent).
Don't create identical card grids with same-sized cards.
Don't use pure white (#ffffff) or pure black (#000000).
Don't use display fonts in UI labels, buttons, or data cells.
Don't mimic Kindle's sterile library or a social feed's engagement metrics.
Don't use cool grays or blue-gray neutrals.
